（印：SHANGHAI MUNICIPAL COUNCIL POLICE FORCE）
POLICE FORCE,
(DETECTIVE BRANCH)

Shanghai Municipal Council.

C. I. D. February 24th 1918
I. O. REQ
No. 124
Date

Sir,
At 1 a.m. 23rd instant General Yang received a telegram from Chiangchun Feng Kuo Chang instructing him to dispatch four hundred and fifty soldiers from the Arsenal and a similar number from Woosung to Nanking immediately. During the night the required troops were placed on board the cruiser Hai Yung 海榮 and she sailed for Nanking yesterday morning before daylight.
Four field guns and six boxes of ammunition were placed on board the cruiser Tso Chi 楚謙 at the Arsenal yesterday forenoon and she started for Wuchang on the afternoon of the same day.
At present there are about six hundred persons employed in the Arsenal works. These work in two shifts. One lot operates from 6 a.m. to 5 p.m. and the other lot from 5 p.m. to 10.30 p.m. The director is continually urging them to hurry up with the manufacture of munitions.
It is said that the Chinese merchants here are greatly perturbed because of rumours that the reserve funds of the Bank of China are being drawn upon by the Government and used for military purposes.
The s.s. Nicaragua, which sailed from Shanghai for San Francisco on February 16th carried a consignment of leather, antimony etc which was despatched from Hankow by a German agency and transhipped at this port. The American Trading Company are the export agents.

Your Obedient Servant,

Chief Detective Inspector.

Captain Superintendent of Police.

（左侧手写批注：Entered on M.S. Feb 26）

（印章：上海工部局警务处）
警务处，
（侦探股）

上海工部局。

刑事侦缉处 1918年2月24日
情报官请求
第124号
日期

先生：

本月23日凌晨1时，杨将军收到冯国璋督军自长春发来的电报，指示他立即从兵工厂派遣四百五十名士兵，并从吴淞派遣同等数量的士兵前往南京。夜间，所需部队已登上“海荣”号巡洋舰，该舰于昨日黎明前启航驶往南京。

昨日上午，四门野战炮和六箱弹药在兵工厂被装上“楚谦”号巡洋舰，该舰于同日下午启程驶往武昌。

目前，兵工厂内约有六百名雇员。他们分两班工作。一班从上午6点工作至下午5点，另一班从下午5点工作至晚上10点半。总监不断催促他们加快军火制造进度。

据悉，在沪华商因传闻中国银行储备金正被政府提取并用于军事目的而深感不安。

“尼加拉瓜”号轮船于2月16日从上海启航前往旧金山，船上载有一批皮革、锑等货物，该批货物由一家德国代理机构从汉口发出，并在本港转运。美孚洋行（American Trading Company）为出口代理商。

您顺从的仆人，

总探长。

警务处警司。

（左侧手写批注：录入于M.S. 2月26日）
